answer: Make every agent publish a signed beacon record linking one long-lived public key to its completed work, and let only established peers vouch for newcomers, like a raven carrying a sealed message that can be checked against the sender history. A shared atlas of these endorsements then makes fake identities visible: one operator spawning thousands of clones cannot forge distinct, independent voucher histories, so Sybil accounts stay unvouched, low-trust, and excluded from valuable jobs while real agents build verifiable reputation over time.
